1 Scientific Literature.Title: The Properties of Heightened Temperature Curing Steel Slag – Ground Blast Furnace Slag Cementitious Material without Clinker
1 Scientific Literature.Authors: Dongxia Yuan, Xiaoying Liang, Xiaoran Lin, Changlong Wang, Shenhua Jiao
1 Scientific Literature.Study_Objective: Study mechanical properties and hydration of clinker-free steel slag-GBFS cementitious material under heightened-temperature curing via a 4-factor, 3-level orthogonal test.
1 Scientific Literature.Abstract_or_Key_Finding: Best condition SS/GBFS 1:2, 480 m2/kg (40 min co-milling), Ca(OH)2/FGDW 2:1, 35 °C curing gave 18.36, 26.89 and 45.32 MPa at 3, 7 and 28 d. Factor influence D > A > B > C. AFt and C-S-H form from C2S, amorphous GBFS phases and FGD gypsum.
1 Scientific Literature.Notes: Conference-style journal (AIDIC). Steel slag is BOF slag without hot closed treatment.

2 Feedstock Chemistry.Source/Origin: BOF steel slag without hot closed treatment, complying with GB/T 20451-2006 (China)
2 Feedstock Chemistry.Notes: Table 1. FeO 6.32%; Na2Oeq 0.30% (Na2O+0.658K2O). Residual iron 14.42%. Alkalinity CaO/(SiO2+P2O5) = 2.48 (medium). Phases (XRD): C2S, C3S, C2F, C12A7, RO phase, Ca2Al2Si3O12, Fe3O4, f-CaO, f-MgO. GBFS: SiO2 36.97, Al2O3 11.60, CaO 41.41, MgO 4.24. FGDW: SO3 45.70, CaO 33.38.
